title: Nicardipine is a putative EED inhibitor and has high selectivity and potency against chemoresistant prostate cancer in preclinical models.
authors: Li, Xin; Chen, Yanhua; Bai, Lijuan; Zhao, Rui; Wu, Yifei; Xie, Zhong-Ru; Wu, Jason M; Bowen, Nathan J; Danaher, Alira; Cook, Nicholas; Li, Dehong; Qui, Min; Du, Yuhong; Fu, Haian; Osunkoya, Adeboye O; Kucuk, Omer; Wu, Daqing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究尼卡地平作为EED抑制剂克服前列腺癌化疗耐药，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法聚焦，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: It is imperative to develop novel therapeutics to overcome chemoresistance, a significant obstacle in the clinical management of prostate cancer (PCa) and other cancers. METHODS: A phenotypic screen was performed to identify novel inhibitors of chemoresistant PCa cells. The mechanism of action of potential candidate(s) was investigated using in silico docking, and molecular and cellular assays in chemoresistant PCa cells. The in vivo efficacy was evaluated in mouse xenograft models of chemoresistant PCa. RESULTS: Nicardipine exhibited high selectivity and potency against chemoresistant PCa cells via inducing apoptosis and cell cycle arrest. Computational, molecular, and cellular studies identified nicardipine as a putative inhibitor of embryonic ectoderm development (EED) protein, and the results are consistent with a proposed mechanism of action that nicardipine destabilised enhancer of zeste homologue 2 (EZH2) and inhibited key components of noncanonical EZH2 signalling, including transducer and activator of transcription 3, S-phase kinase-associated protein 2, ATP binding cassette B1, and survivin. As a monotherapy, nicardipine effectively inhibited the skeletal growth of chemoresistant C4-2B-TaxR tumours. As a combination regimen, nicardipine synergistically enhanced the in vivo efficacy of docetaxel against C4-2 xenografts. CONCLUSION: Our findings provided the first preclinical evidence supporting nicardipine as a novel EED inhibitor that has the potential to be promptly tested in PCa patients to overcome chemoresistance and improve clinical outcomes.
abstract_zh: 背景：开发新型疗法以克服化疗耐药性势在必行，这是前列腺癌（PCa）及其他癌症临床管理中的重大障碍。方法：进行表型筛选以鉴定化疗耐药性PCa细胞的新型抑制剂。通过计算机模拟对接以及化疗耐药性PCa细胞中的分子和细胞学检测，研究了潜在候选药物的作用机制。在化疗耐药性PCa的小鼠异种移植模型中评估了体内疗效。结果：尼卡地平通过诱导凋亡和细胞周期阻滞，对化疗耐药性PCa细胞表现出高选择性和高效力。计算、分子和细胞学研究将尼卡地平鉴定为胚胎外胚层发育（EED）蛋白的推定抑制剂，结果与提出的作用机制一致，即尼卡地平使zeste同源物2增强子（EZH2）不稳定，并抑制非经典EZH2信号传导的关键组分，包括信号转导和转录激活因子3、S期激酶相关蛋白2、ATP结合盒B1和survivin。作为单一疗法，尼卡地平有效抑制了化疗耐药性C4-2B-TaxR肿瘤的骨骼生长。作为联合方案，尼卡地平协同增强了多西他赛对C4-2异种移植瘤的体内疗效。结论：我们的发现提供了首个临床前证据，支持尼卡地平作为一种新型EED抑制剂，有望在PCa患者中迅速测试以克服化疗耐药性并改善临床结局。
